question: In which year did India win the men's Hockey World Cup?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1975.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India **won the **first World Cup title** in** Hockey** in **1975, **which was held in** Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.**
 
• In the final match, **India defeated Pakistan** by** 2-1** to lift the trophy.
 
• This was a** historic moment** for Indian hockey as it marked the first time that India had won a **major international tournament **in **15 years.**
 
• The captain of the Indian team at that time was **Ajit Pal Singh, **who led the team to victory and was also awarded the **Player of the Tournament title**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• In 1971, India won the the bronze medal, Lost to West Germany in the semi-finals, but defeated France in the bronze medal match.
 
• India did not win the World Cup title in 1982.
 
 
• In fact, India did not even qualify for the 1982 World Cup, which was held in Mumbai, India.
 
 

Achievements:

 
• World Cup: Won their only title in 1975.
 
• Olympics: Hold a record eight gold medals (1928, 1932, 1936, 1948, 1952, 1956, 1964, 1980).
 
• Asian Games: Won 4 gold medals, 9 Silver medals, 3 Bronze medals
 
• Commonwealth Games: Won 3 Silver medals (2010*, 2014, 2022) and 2 times fourth place (1998, 2018)

Current Status:

 
• Ranked 5th in the world by the International Hockey Federation (FIH).
 
• Facing challenges like lack of infrastructure and funding, but also has a strong youth development program.
